data.name: Boulos
data.long_meaning:
Originated from the Arabic word 'bulus' which means 'rich'. This name is mentioned in the Quran for a person who was described as having a great amount of wealth.

From Surah Al-Imran, verse 134: 'And remember the favor of Allah upon you and His covenant [that He made] with you when you said, 'We will assign [to Allah] from our wealth a [fixed] amount.' And it is He Who has hearing and knowledge.'
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes abundance and wealth from Allah.
